scope: Proposition 6.9 (Cellular sewing stability with margins) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Suppose admissible discrete contour excursions have actual sphere cell complexes, converge uniformly to contours whose finite-chain quotient is a sphere, and satisfy the link approximation and chronological conditions (T1)–(T3) and Equation 6.2. In particular, the scalar approximation hypothesis includes any separately prescribed generators at exceptional or distinguished times. Let z ∈ S2 have finite fiber S = η−1(z), and let J be a finite union of open retained time intervals containing S. Choose closed topological disks about z with E−1 ⋐ int E0 ⋐ int E1 ⋐ int E2 ⋐ int E3 ⋐ int E4, η−1 (E4) ⊂ J. For every fixed integer r ≥ 0 and sufficiently large j, there are nested cellular disks ∆− j ⋐ int ∆+ j such that π−1 j (E0) ⊂ int ∆− j ⊂ ∆− j ⊂ π−1 j (int E1), π−1 j (E2) ⊂ int ∆+ j ⊂ ∆+ j ⊂ π−1 j (int E3). Writing Aj = ∆+ j \ int ∆− j : (i) Aj is a closed cellular annulus and contains π−1 j (E2 \ int E1). (ii) Every original triangle in Sr j (∆+ j ) has its entire chronological interval in J. In particular, taking r ≥ 1 retains complete primal and dual vertex stars of every original triangle meeting the disk. (iii) Every original triangle in Sr j (Aj) has its chronological interval in a fixed compact subset of J \ S, up to an arbitrarily small fixed open time enlargement still contained there. It can therefore be covered by finitely many off-center time blocks, chosen with positive margins. (iv) Robust transverse primal crossings in the annular region have the actual intersections asserted by Corollary 6.6. A closed primal walk there with nonzero projected winding difference about z and a point of S2 \ E4 contains a simple primal circuit surrounding π−1 j (E0). Its chosen interior is contained in ∆+ j , so its interior and the required fixed number of cell-star layers lie in the retained patch. All conclusions are topological. They bound neither the length of an auxiliary joining path nor a normalized endpoint cost.
